periods.time: Lux's western visit and later epilogue
periods.label: Langris heiress and queen

name.jp: セリスティア・ラルグリス

periods.occupation: Drag-Ride pilot, noble heiress, lecturer, queen

status.role: prepares to manage the western territory and teach at the academy

appearance.overview: Tall, dignified noblewoman with a graceful presence; appears in a pale green dress during the banquet and later as lecturer and pilot.

personality.summary: Strong, dutiful and lonely beneath her perfect exterior; learns to ask Lux for comfort.
fears: being unable to make her mother proud
personality.inner_conflict: Her life of never relying on others finally relaxes when her mother tells her to live for her own happiness.

decision_pattern.style: endures first, asks for affection only when trust is absolute

address_pattern.lux-arcadia: 路克斯 / 路克斯学弟

habits.daily_routine: studies territory management and teaches as special lecturer after graduation
quirks: once spoke to cats and dolls when unable to ask people for comfort

background.upbringing: Raised under pressure as the daughter of a major noble family without a male heir.
formative_events: training to become stronger than men
background.pre_story: Former strongest academy student and captain-level heroine.

lux-arcadia.summary: He accompanies her to the western territory and lets her rely on him.

dist-langris.summary: He entrusts Celistia to Lux and warns him about noble family pressures.

ilse-langris.summary: Ilse tells Celistia she has already saved her and should now live for her own happiness.

seren-triaden.summary: Sharis teases her in the epilogue as a former senior and guard.

philphy-aignram.summary: Fights beside her in the epilogue.

periods.summary: Celistia's episode focuses on family reconciliation and vulnerability: after serving noble guests, she meets her mother Ilse, asks Lux to let her be spoiled, and later becomes a lecturer while still longing for him.

key_events.summary: Visits the western territory with Lux, receives Ilse's blessing, and shares a vulnerable night with him.
Destroys fleeing Abysses with her golden Divine Drag-Ride in the epilogue battle.
